text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin has been enormously
successful over
the past three years, and
now, thanks to those
great results...

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's Yukino!
You're so cool!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: She's almost too bright to even look at. Sigh... She's just so wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: G-gee will'kers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is taken aback by the
adoring eyes
of the younger students.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What?! C'mon, you're start'n t'sound like
my dad!
choice_data_list: すっかり学園のマドンナだな
すっかり学園のマドンナだね
choice_data_list_en: You've become the academy's darling, huh.
You've become the academy's darling, haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's like... things feel different from
b'fore. Maybe
it's the way I'm gett'n so
much attention now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sure, people're still call'n me things
like...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C-cute...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And c-cool... and wonderful... but I
dunno... It
feels diff'rent...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yukinoooo!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heyyy! Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Led by Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet, a
group of
Umamusume preparing for their
debuts come our
way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What're you all doing here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We want to ask you something, Yukino...
Could
you tell us how you've done as
well as you have?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
After all, there really aren't that many

Umamusume out there who have won the
Triple
Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! Ask any pre-debut students
who they
see as the fiercest racer and
they'll say you for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-the fiercest racer?!
choice_data_list: （なるほど、それで注目されてるのか）
（なるほど、それで注目されてるんだ）
choice_data_list_en: (I see, so that's why she's getting attention.)
(I see, so that's why everyone's looking at her.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Well that just tickles me pink!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning on aiming for the Triple
Tiara once I
debut.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I wanna try my best, just like
you! So
could you tell us something
about your journey!
Anything will help!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I dunno how good of a speaker I
am... but
I'll give it the ol' college try!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-this hall is GINORMOUS! I'm s'posed to talk here?!

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo! Thanks for coming today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And where'd all these people come
from?! What
in the world's going on
here?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here is running on the Tiara
tour.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
So naturally, all of us look up to the
Triple Tiara
champion!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see... So winn'n is only half the story...
With great
dazzle comes great
responsibility...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, everybody! Would you all mind if I
choose
the topic for t'day?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna make sure I'm doing right by the
Triple
Tiara by tell'n my story properly,
with m'own
words!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That sounds great, thank you! We
were
actually hoping you'd do that
anyway. The floor's
yours, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...So, my trainer and I made sure to do a
loooot
of train'n t'gether.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But t'tell the truth, winn'n the Shuka Sho
wasn't
quite what I expected...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So I never actually got t'celebrate winn'n
the
Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But being here and gett'n to talk in front
of all of
you—it feels like I'm finally
gett'n that chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she finishes her talk, Yukino Bijin
seems just a
little bit more mature than
before.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Triple Tiara is an amazing

achievement in itself, but you won the
Victoria
Mile and the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously awesome! Just ask
anyone
waiting to debut—you're a
legend!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A legend?!
choice_data_list: （なるほど、それで注目されてるのか）
（なるほど、それで注目されてるんだ）
choice_data_list_en: (I see, so that's why she's getting attention.)
(I see, so that's why everyone's looking at her.)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A total legend! I wanna rack up that many wins too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I can forge my own legend! I'll be
Vodka the
Legendary!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That name's the berries!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I know, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I bet you know the trick to winning a
whole bunch
of races, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, tell us. How'd you get so
awesome?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You gotta have guts!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Guts?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeppers! That's the one thing I can say
I've got
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Um, but what about, like, coming up
with
strategies or honing your strengths?
You know,
that kinda stuff.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Guts is what got me through it all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: G-guts...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What? That's an important aspect of
running your
best. Why are you
confused?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just... thought she was gonna say
something
cool! Y'know, something with
style!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nope, I'm not one of those cool, styl'n
types.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Think'n back, no matter what kinda day
it
was—rainy, snowy, windy—all I ever
did was run
and run.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But y'know...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm liv'n proof of what happens when all
you do is
run!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa... Wait, that's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now I get it... Guts are awesome! Thanks
for
showing me the light, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now c'mon! Share some of your guts with
me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'd love to! Just try t'keep up!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...If only it were that simple.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But we're serious too! There's no way you two are leaving us in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the whole crowd watching, Yukino
Bijin
charges ahead, full of energy.
Seeing her, I can
tell she's become a city
girl in her own right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You ran so well in the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool! You even ran in a bunch
of G1
races!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so you were watch'n me, huh?
Thanks a
bunch!
choice_data_list: （なるほど、それで注目されてるのか）
（なるほど、それで注目されてるんだ）
choice_data_list_en: (I see, so that's why she's getting attention.)
(I see, so that's why everyone's looking at her.)

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
So basically, Yukino, we want you to tell
us all
about your racing experiences!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, throwing yourself into the fray
without a
thought is cool too, but then
Scarlet said—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I said we just can't waste an opportunity
to learn
from someone so experienced!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So please, tell us everything! I'm sure it'll come in handy during our own journeys!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: You don't mind, do you, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you're good with li'l ol' me, then of
course I
don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We've been waiting for you, Yukino. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh? You're here too, Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! I heard "tiara" and got curious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I bought some sweet treats too, so let's
snack and
chat!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There are cookies, financier cakes...
Take your
pick! ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow, these're all so fancy!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Can I join too? I brought some drinks!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Have we got any potato chips? I'll go
see what's
at the store!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-not gonna lie, this is sounding more
and more
like a picnic by the second...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nothing wrong with that, right? I'm
gonna grab
something salty to snack on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, well, at least we're guaranteed
t'have a
roar'n good time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch over Yukino Bijin as she chats
happily
away, surrounded by her friends.
